modalities.evidence: proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy of the left hippocampus

output.population: 142 healthy participants recruited from the general population, ages 18–25; MRI data available for 139
output.summary: Cross-sectional study of healthy adults with high or low schizotypy combining clinical and cognitive testing, multimodal MRI including resting-state fMRI, hippocampal spectroscopy and arterial spin labeling, and gut microbiota sequencing.
